title: Focal length, subject distance and perspective distortion

queue.claim: Ward, Ward, Fried & Paskhover (2018) found that at 12 in (~30 cm) the nasal base appears ~30% (men) / ~29% (women) wider than at 5 ft (~1.5 m), using a computational head model.
queue.query: Ward Fried Paskhover 2018 selfie effect nasal base width 30% 12 inches 5 feet

queue.claim: EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFilm is derived from the diagonal crop factor (43.27 mm / sensor diagonal) rather than sensor width; the two differ by ~4% on 4:3 sensors.
queue.query: Exif FocalLengthIn35mmFilm definition CIPA DC-008 equivalent focal length diagonal or width

queue.claim: Blender's 3D viewport perspective applies a fixed 2x zoom (CAMERA_PARAM_ZOOM_INIT_PERSP), so a 50 mm viewport focal length matches roughly a 25 mm camera on a 36 mm sensor.
queue.query: CAMERA_PARAM_ZOOM_INIT_PERSP Blender viewport lens focal length twice camera

queue.claim: ICAO portrait-quality guidance and ISO/IEC 19794-5 / 39794-5 specify a camera-to-subject distance of roughly 1.2–2.5 m for ID photos.
queue.query: ICAO portrait quality camera subject distance 1.2 m 2.5 m ISO/IEC 39794-5
